title: Anime character hero with an occluded wordmark and a one-hue orange panel
contains_third_party_content: Anime character from a licensed series (copyrighted).

observed.layout: Peach page with an offset orange panel and a soft shadow. Giant condensed cream capitals spell the character's name behind the figure, which stands in front and hides letters so it reads 'BAK_OU'. The figure wears an orange T-shirt printed 'A BAND' (close to the panel color), dark sleeves and spiky blonde hair, and holds drumsticks. Left stack: HOME (bold white), ABOUT, CONTACT, GALLERY (lighter). Top-left menu glyph; top-right '05' over a vertical bar; bottom-right 'Scroll Down' underlined. A thin circle halo sits behind the figure.
observed.hierarchy: Figure, then the giant name, then the nav.
observed.typography: Condensed all-caps wordmark; small sans nav. Typeface unconfirmed.
observed.materials: Flat panel with a soft shadow; layered text behind a cut-out figure.

interpretation.aesthetic: Monochrome warm, music-poster feel; the shirt color matches the panel so the figure feels sewn into the page.
implementation_notes: Text-behind-subject: the wordmark sits on a layer below a transparent cut-out figure.
Counter '05' and 'Scroll Down' imply a vertical carousel.

concept_work.essence: Depth from occlusion, calm from a single hue.
what_makes_it_work: The figure overlapping the name creates depth.
One hue family keeps the page calm.
Dark sleeves and hair carry the silhouette.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Nav labels measure about 1.45-2.24:1 (HOME to GALLERY).
'Scroll Down' and the counter measure about 2.18:1.
The site's purpose is unclear: no offer or action beyond scrolling.
The hidden letters make the name unreadable as content.

links: The counter and scroll cue imply a vertical carousel.
The shirt color ties the figure to the panel.

approach: Layered divs: wordmark below a transparent cut-out

pattern.name: Occluded wordmark hero
use_when: A person or character is the product (artists, athletes, characters)
must_preserve: Subject in front of the text
Subject clothing tied to the panel color
adaptation_examples: Athlete profile hero in team colors.
Musician site: stage name behind a cut-out portrait.
failure_modes: Pale nav on a mid-tone panel

lessons: Tie the subject's clothing to the panel color to integrate a cut-out.
Check pale nav items on mid-tone fields.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: One warm hue family: peach page, orange panel, cream lettering; darks only in the figure's sleeves and hair.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: It is clear who the page is about, but the site's offer or action is not.
Strong depth and a calm one-hue palette.
Hero and nav conventions are met, but pale nav labels and no action weaken correctness.
No states shown; only a scroll cue as an action.
One hue, one wordmark style and consistent nav.
Text-behind-subject is a known technique executed well.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 1.45:1; secondary text min 2.18:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

critical_failures.description: A primary text/label measures below 3:1 contrast (best estimate)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
